lines.say: Welcome to Class 22. Telling Stories: The Past Continuous.
Rule one. Use was or were with a verb-ing for an action in progress in the past.

show.text: Use was or were with a verb-ing for an action in progress in the past.
show.bn: অতীতে চলমান কোনো কাজ বোঝাতে was বা were-এর সঙ্গে verb-ing ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: I was walking to the metro at eight o'clock.

show.text: I was walking to the metro at eight o'clock.
show.bn: আমি রাত আটটায় মেট্রো স্টেশনে হেঁটে যাচ্ছিলাম।

lines.say: Notice was.

show.text: I was walking to the metro at eight o'clock.
show.bn: আমি রাত আটটায় মেট্রো স্টেশনে হেঁটে যাচ্ছিলাম।

lines.say: She was studying in the library.

show.text: She was studying in the library.

lines.say: Notice was.

show.text: She was studying in the library.

lines.say: Rule two. Use while for the longer action and when for the shorter action.

show.text: Use while for the longer action and when for the shorter action.
show.bn: নিয়ম ২: দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে চলা কাজ বোঝাতে while এবং স্বল্প সময়ের ঘটনা বোঝাতে when ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: While I was walking, it started to rain.

show.text: While I was walking, it started to rain.

lines.say: Notice while, and was.

show.text: While I was walking, it started to rain.

lines.say: I was reading when she called.

show.text: I was reading when she called.
show.bn: আমি বই পড়ছিলাম, এমন সময় সে ফোন করল।

lines.say: Notice was.

show.text: I was reading when she called.
show.bn: আমি বই পড়ছিলাম, এমন সময় সে ফোন করল।

lines.say: Not: I was walk to the metro. Say: I was walking to the metro.
Meanwhile, Mariam was waiting outside.
Meanwhile.
Suddenly, it started to rain.
Suddenly.
Sound corner. The -ing ending and linking was.

show.bn: Sound corner: -ing-এর শেষাংশ এবং was-এর সঙ্গে যুক্ত করে উচ্চারণ।

lines.say: I was reading a book.
Do not drop the -ing ending.
Review the examples, then try the lesson!
